title: 2024 draft capital budget and neighbourhood speed pilot
subtitle: Also: conservation authority agreement, St. David Street crossing, OLG funding policy, demolition control repeal, and a deferred rezoning.
overview: The Committee of the Whole recommended that staff carry the 2024 preliminary draft capital budget and the 10-year bridge and major culverts plan into the 2024 draft budget {{vote:m4}}. Projects reviewed included the St. David Street North reconstruction, East Mill Street Phase 2, water and wastewater upgrades and a new operations centre. The committee also supported a temporary increase in development charge contributions to the capital budget by consensus.

On road safety, the committee recommended a new controlled pedestrian crossing at St. David Street North and St. George Street {{vote:m7}}. It also recommended a 40 km/h pilot in one urban neighbourhood, with community consultation to follow {{vote:m8}}. It recommended entering a memorandum of understanding with the Grand River Conservation Authority {{vote:m3}} and repealing the Township's demolition control by-law {{vote:m12}}.

A rezoning application for 820 St. David St. N. was not approved. The committee recommended sending it back to staff for options on more public consultation {{vote:m11}}. Delegations on arts funding and by-law enforcement will be tracked and reported back during budget deliberations on December 7, 2023. Nothing was reported out of closed session. These recommendations go to Council for adoption.

decisions.detail: The committee recommended including the 2024 Preliminary Draft Capital Budget and the Bridge and Major Culverts 10 Year Plan in the 2024 Draft Budget.
The committee recommended entering the Memorandum of Understanding with the Grand River Conservation Authority and delegating signing authority to the Mayor and Clerk.
The committee recommended using the existing OLG Funding Allocation Policy for the 2024 budget, with a review during the 2025 budget process.
The committee recommended a new controlled pedestrian crossing at St. George Street, built with the reconstruction project, and received the project update for information.
The committee recommended authorizing staff to pilot 40 km/h speed limits in one urban neighbourhood, begin community consultation and report back.
The committee recommended referring application RZ05/18 back to staff for a report on options for additional public consultation.
The committee recommended repealing By-law 2007-021, which designated the Township as an area subject to demolition control.
The committee recommended including the 2024 staff initiatives in the Draft 2024 Business Plan, with any changes tracked and presented during budget deliberations.
